mentions.name: Nile
mentions.description: An AI-powered data engineering platform, described as "Data Engineer in a box" or "Cursor for Data", that abstracts away tedious parts of data engineering work. Its MVP manages compute, storage, lineage, versioning, and pipeline building for datasets, letting companies focus on the data they want to store and the questions they have about it.
mentions.problem: A lot of data engineering practiced today is non-differentiated across companies, so they would rather spend that time on differentiated tasks than on tedious DE work.
mentions.audience: Companies practicing data engineering that would rather spend time on differentiated work
mentions.source_excerpt: Three of us friends are working on "Data Engineer in a box" or "Cursor for Data": https://getnile.ai
